commands.name: system.hello
commands.notes: Local ESP handshake; controlMode=direct. It never starts outputs. Device capabilities remain required.
commands.integration_change: AFR2-20261029-27; v9 source only; local session priority, mode7/manual-pwm, byte4 motor enable, numeric actions70/71 and contextual long/back

commands.name: system.alive
commands.notes: 500ms heartbeat with interactive presence (visible and focused). ESP relays observed age; no grant/token/enable.
commands.integration_change: AFR2-20261029-27; v9 source only; local session priority, mode7/manual-pwm, byte4 motor enable, numeric actions70/71 and contextual long/back

commands.name: robot.stop
commands.notes: Priority STOP invalidates older queued actions. completed confirms output shutdown, not measured zero wheel speed.

commands.name: robot.state
commands.notes: State with origin=none/local/web, fault, preferences and optional valid pose. No permission state or inferred position.

optional_extensions_design.pose: afr2-pose-1; design-only, AVR/ESP producer pending; no UART assignment

commands.integration_change: AFR2-20261029-27; v9 source only; local session priority, mode7/manual-pwm, byte4 motor enable, numeric actions70/71 and contextual long/back
commands.source_note: EX01v10 appends configurationDirty and longPressMs to state response.

commands.name: robot.drive
commands.notes: Direct bounded Mecanum command, TTL200..1000ms (Web400ms), one in flight/latest replacement. No automatic resumption.

commands.name: robot.mode
commands.notes: Direct idle/manual/line-follow; device checks state and calibration. Connecting or observing mode never starts motion.

commands.name: robot.test.wheel
commands.notes: Direct bounded PWM/duration100..2000ms. accepted means test started, not physical test completion.

commands.name: robot.sensors
commands.notes: Five line channels and HC-SR04 with validity/age; absent or stale samples are null, never fabricated zero.

commands.name: robot.encoders
commands.notes: Four wheel counts with wiring/validity/age. Hall not connected or calibrated remains unavailable.

commands.name: robot.calibrate
commands.notes: Direct numeric CONFIG RAM write with stopped outputs/no EEPROM or Hall measurement in progress. Prefix reserved0, no token. Save separately.
commands.integration_change: AFR2-20261029-27; v9 source only; local session priority, mode7/manual-pwm, byte4 motor enable, numeric actions70/71 and contextual long/back

commands.name: robot.goto.start
commands.notes: Direct relative XY/theta target, valid odometry/calibration, bounded speed and60s timeout. accepted is not arrival.

commands.name: robot.goto.cancel
commands.notes: Cancels current GOTO and shuts down outputs. STOP is also always available.

commands.name: robot.screen.get
commands.notes: Coherent1024byte framebuffer via META/PAGE/RELEASE, no reconstruction or credential exposure. ESP requires an enabled per-session robot.screen.subscribe, renewed within3500ms.

commands.name: robot.ui.action

req.revision: uint32 snapshot revision; required for EX01

commands.notes: Revision/generation/age-guarded rotate/select/long-menu. Preserves physical-only actions and privacy; no access switch. back=3 requires negotiated feature0x20000 and activates only the explicit Volver item of current menu with original service semantics.
commands.integration_change: AFR2-20261029-27; v9 source only; local session priority, mode7/manual-pwm, byte4 motor enable, numeric actions70/71 and contextual long/back

commands.name: robot.sequence.begin

req.name: string
req.executionMode: timed(default)|independent-wheels|barrier-wheels; last two require extension>=6 and distanceBlocks

commands.notes: Prepares bounded program32records/120s; physical execution remains Hall/calibration/memory gated. No motion on upload.

commands.name: robot.sequence.append
commands.notes: Strict next index and bounded time/pulse record. Prefix reserved0 and program identity; no permission token.

commands.name: robot.sequence.commit
commands.notes: Checks complete record count/durations/chains; does not execute or approve memory/Hall.

commands.name: robot.sequence.start
commands.notes: Direct start of committed program with new execution identity and device requirements; no permission acquisition.

commands.name: robot.sequence.cancel
commands.notes: Priority cancellation by program/execution identity; STOP remains available without those identities.
commands.priority_transport: EX01 0x44 reserved priority slot; authoritative output shutdown, global STOP 0x06 fallback

commands.name: robot.sequence.status
commands.notes: Read execution/program state within the transport session. Automatic status polls do not refresh interactive presence.

commands.name: wifi.status

res.securityCode: 0 unknown / 1 open / 2 WEP / 3 WPA / 4 WPA2 / 5 WPA-WPA2 / 6 protected

commands.notes: Local ESP status independent of Mega. Credentials are never included in this report.

commands.name: wifi.scan
commands.notes: Asynchronous local scan; accepted is start, terminal event distinguishes result/empty/error/timeout.

commands.name: wifi.configure

req.password: string (ephemeral, never logged or persisted in web storage)
req.persist: boolean optional, default true; ESP LittleFS only, never browser storage

commands.notes: Local validated STA/AP/AP_STA config, RAM or explicit persistence. accepted is not completed radio connection.

commands.name: robot.config.get
commands.notes: Read a shared numeric CONFIG action without preparing control; wheel/IR channel are shared device context.

commands.name: robot.preferences
commands.notes: Explicit save/discard. save is accepted until later state confirms EEPROM completion; RAM is not persistence.

commands.name: robot.line.calibrate
commands.notes: Explicit confirm/invalidate, stopped outputs and device conditions; does not create a measured calibration.

commands.name: wifi.draft.submit

req.persist: boolean, applied only on physical Connect

commands.notes: RAM draft for the current physical OLED job; only physical Connect applies it. Never stored in browser/logs.

commands.name: wifi.draft.cancel
commands.notes: Explicit matching OLED job cancellation and secret disposal; does not apply radio configuration.

commands.name: system.info

res.filesystem: ESP filesystem health and optional accepted Web package identity; SYSTEM_INFO_FILESYSTEM_15.md

commands.notes: Device identity and local filesystem/package diagnostic. Missing ATmega data is null; no fabricated identity.

commands.name: system.reboot
commands.notes: Explicit target/confirm; stopped outputs and EEPROM conditions. accepted schedules restart; boot event confirms a later observation.

payload_schema.res: same as servo.get; applied pulse may still differ from target

commands.name: robot.screen.status
commands.notes: ESP requires an enabled per-session robot.screen.subscribe, renewed within3500ms.

commands.name: robot.screen.subscribe
commands.notes: Per-session broker gate. Renewal1000ms; expires3500ms. No UART command or autonomous framebuffer push. Disable invalidates session capture; disconnect clears session.

commands.name: robot.touch.ui
commands.notes: EX01v10 required. Four-byte body enabled,direction,heading,powerPercent. Renewals only update UI. First enable retains existing takeover STOP. Latest power notice1200ms; percent is not applied wheel PWM.

commands.name: system.battery.get
commands.notes: EX01v9 feature0x40000; body byte0=Get/1=Measure. Source only. See BATTERY_MEASUREMENT_9.md.

commands.name: system.battery.measure
commands.notes: EX01v9 feature0x40000; body byte0=Get/1=Measure. Source only. See BATTERY_MEASUREMENT_9.md.

commands.name: robot.drive.pwm
commands.notes: EX01v9 feature0x80000. Signed percentages of the configured PWM limit, central AVR mecanum mix, ramps and watchdog/STOP. No HC/odometry requirement. Explicit motor enable required. No automatic restart after reconnect.

commands.name: wifi.disconnect
commands.notes: Accepted is not disconnected. Completion requires observed staConnected=false. Suppresses automatic reconnect until explicit retry/configure; preserves stored credentials.

commands.name: wifi.retry
commands.notes: Requires STA interface and stored credentials; actual connection observed separately. AP-only is unavailable.

commands.name: wifi.mode
commands.notes: Session-only radio mode; does not replace credentials. completed confirmed=true only after actual SDK mode/AP start observed.

atmega_extension.name: EX01
atmega_extension.note: Separate from designed profile3; existing wire_id/profile3 fields are preserved.

oled_network_channel.transport: UART only, no new WS commands
oled_network_channel.apPassword: local OLED only; remote capture withheld

wifi_ui.updateSubtype4: 18-byte current metadata; follows acknowledged base status
wifi_ui.result6: no ready WebSocket client, only WEB_DRAFT

motion_reference.logicalAxes: X forward / Y left / yaw CCW
